none.$description: Horizontal offset. none for standard elevation; larger steps only for directional shadows, which must flip in RTL.

-8.$description: Negative spread tightens the shadow so it sits under the object rather than haloing it.

primary.$description: The main font. Change this one value and every text style follows.

mono.$description: Fixed-width font for code blocks and number columns.

tighter.$description: -2% · Very large text (Figma applies this value in px.)

tight.$description: -1% · Headings (Figma applies this value in px.)

none.$description: 0% · Body and labels (Figma applies this value in px.)

wide.$description: 2% · Slightly spread (Figma applies this value in px.)

wider.$description: 4% · UPPERCASE labels (Figma applies this value in px.)
